items.quote: Everyone says cold calling doesn't work in Dubai.
items.statement: Cold calling is said not to work in Dubai.

items.quote: But if you need listings — and your Instagram funnels, manifestos, and networking coffees aren’t getting them… Then it’s time to try what actually works.
items.statement: If Instagram funnels and networking aren't effective, one should try cold calling.

items.quote: In this video, I break down the cold calling script that’s working right now to get agents new listings.
items.statement: A video explains a cold calling script that helps agents get new listings.

items.quote: You’ll hear how to say it, what tone to use — and why it works.
items.statement: The post emphasizes the importance of tone and delivery in cold calling.

items.quote: And Share is with your Team if you want more inventory.
items.statement: The post encourages sharing the video with teams for better inventory.

overview: A LinkedIn post discussing the effectiveness of cold calling in Dubai.
